title: Walnut Creek Annexation Public Hearing
summary:
*   The primary focus was a public hearing for the full annexation of the Walnut Creek Municipal Annexation Plan Area.
*   This annexation proposal covered approximately 315 acres located northwest of Braker Lane and Dessau Road.
*   City staff presented information from departments like transportation, water, and legal services before the public hearing was closed.
transcript:
CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL CALLED MINUTES 
MONDAY, JUNK 9. 2003
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
MONDAY, JUNE 9,2003
The City Council of Austin, Texas, convened in a Special Called Meeting on Monday, June 9, 2003
at the Wood cliff Baptist Church. 11015 Dessau Road, Austin, Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m.
Conduct a public hearing for the full purpose annexation of the Walnut Creek Municipal Annexation Plan
Area (Approximately 315 acres located northwest of the intersection of Braker Lane and Dessau Road).
The presentation was made by Ben Luckens, Transportation, Planning and Sustainability; Michael
Boyle, P.E., Water and Wastewater Department; Lisa Gordon, Assistant City Manager; and David
Lloyd, Law Department.
The public hearing was closed on Council Member Slushor's motion, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman's
second on a 4-0 vote. Council Members Alvarez, Thomas, and \Vynn were absent.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 7:35 p.m. was approved on Council Member Slushcr's
motion, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman's second on a 4-0 vote. Council Members Alvarez, Thomas, and
Wvnn were absent.
